name: Jennifer Espinoza
source: Jen is one of the producers of America's Most Eligible and one of Your Character's love interests. She made her first appearance in Book 1, Chapter 1. While she is shown to be sweet and kind, she cannot be impartial when it comes to her job as a producer, as is noted by Piper, due to her clear favoritism towards Your Character when compared to her other contestants; this is likely because of her crush on Your Character. Her mother describes her as hard-working and caring in Book 3, Chapter 9.
